channel.title: New York Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: Nicki Minaj shows off Trump Gold Card for legal U.S. residency, got it ‘free of charge’
item.description: Nicki Minaj is relishing in the rewards for her recent support for the MAGA movement, saying she was given a Trump Gold Car free of charge.

item.title: NYPD releases body-cam footage of fatal police shooting of man at Brooklyn hospital
item.description: The NYPD released body-cam footage Thursday that shows the fatal police shooting of a former cop and FDNY lieutenant armed with a shard of porcelain following a tense standoff inside a Brooklyn Hospital.

item.title: Decades later, convicted killer of Harlem mother and daughter sentenced to 40 years
item.description: In furious remarks, a judge said Larry Atkinson had targeted two of society's most vulnerable and waited decades to show remorse.

item.title: Olympic sprinter Sha’Carri Richardson arrested for speeding over 100 mph
item.description: Olympic medal-winning sprinter Sha'Carri Richardson was arrested in Florida on a charge of dangerous excessive speeding. She was allegedly driving 104 mph.

item.title: South African distributor yanks ‘Melania’ doc nationwide hours before debut
item.description: The South African distributor of the documentary “Melania” pulled the film from theaters hours before it was to debut Friday, citing “recent developments.”

item.title: Inside Brooke Nevils’ memoir detailing rape allegations against Matt Lauer
item.description: Brooke Nevils, a former NBC News producer who accused Matt Lauer of raping her in 2014, is revisiting the brutal experience in her upcoming memoir.

item.title: ‘The Blind Side’ star Quinton Aaron suffered spinal stroke: report
item.description: "The Blind Side" star Quinton Aaron suffered a spinal stroke prior to his recent hospitalization, his family said.

item.title: Islanders’ Carson Soucy scores against his former team in 2-1 victory over Rangers
item.description: Soucy became the first player to score for the Rangers and the Islanders at Madison Square Garden in the same season.

item.title: Michael Porter Jr. pours in 38 in return to Denver, but Nets fall short late
item.description: The loss was Brooklyn’s seventh straight and its 15th in the last 17 games.
